kurz: Crisp chips come from two baths: first cook, then dry and brown.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Cut and soak in cold water
schluesselmomente.warum: Rinses off the loose starch film that sticks and browns too early.
Water on the surface costs heat and spits.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Pre-fry pale at about 160 °C and let cool
schluesselmomente.warum: The inside cooks and a thin skin forms.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Fry at about 190 °C until golden brown
schluesselmomente.warum: The skin dries out quickly and turns crisp.
